title: Use the bash-aware argv for the Claude background-end registration comparison, and require a valid empty args array for an empty tail
outcome: A Claude Bash background launcher whose focused command contains words bash rewrites (such as an unquoted backslash escape like `my\ crate`) is matched against its registration by the argv bash actually passes. A registration whose recorded focused stage args are missing or malformed never compares equal to an empty planned tail.
acceptance: Use the bash-aware argv for the Claude background-end registration comparison, and require a valid empty args array for an empty tail is done
